Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a compact condition-check sheet for `Before the House Wakes` using its last verified mounting and damage baseline. Describe the full mounting setup, not only the corner that was repaired, and include the known sheet, mat, window, and mount materials and sizes. Check January 4, 2028 and, if 6:00 PM Central is free, add a 15-minute routine annual inspection reminder.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Before the House Wakes — condition-check sheet", "body": "# Before the House Wakes — condition check

**Baseline:** Last verified January 4, 2026, after replacing the shifted lower-right mount.

## Mounting setup
- 9 × 12 in full sheet; 140-lb cold-press watercolor paper; painted image 7 × 9 in.
- 11 × 14 in archival mat with a 6.75 × 8.75 in window.
- Sheet held by conservation-grade corner mounts (including the replaced lower-right corner); no pressure-sensitive adhesive contacts the artwork.
- Framed assembly includes glazing; sheet is separated from the glazing. Glazing type, frame dimensions/material, and backing-board material are not specified in the verified notes. The former 10 × 12 in frame was replaced and is not the current setup.

## Check gently
- Confirm the sheet remains flat; inspect for moisture, tears, abrasion, staining, buckling, or other change.
- Check all corner mounts are seated and holding evenly; verify no mount or adhesive touches the painted sheet.
- Confirm the mat and window are unchanged, the sheet remains clear of glazing, and the assembly is secure.
- If damage, moisture, contact, or a shifted mount is found, stop handling and seek conservation advice rather than pressing, taping, or repairing the sheet.

**Last verified condition:** Sheet flat and undamaged, with no moisture, tear, abrasion, or adhesive contact; only the lower-right corner mount had shifted and was replaced. Reassembled securely in the Cherrywood painting corner; no further repair or professional intervention was pending. This is a dated baseline, not a claim about the present condition.", "folder": "Watercolor inventory"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_131_06", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document is a compact condition-check sheet for `Before the House Wakes`. It identifies the verified setup and baseline: the 9-by-12-inch sheet uses conservation-grade corner mounts with an 11-by-14-inch mat and a 6.75-by-8.75-inch window; the lower-right corner mount was replaced; the work is in the Cherrywood painting corner; and the sheet was flat and undamaged with no moisture, tear, abrasion, or adhesive contact. It provides practical checks for mount security, sheet flatness, the named damage categories, and the unchanged mat and window, and says no conservation repair or professional intervention is currently pending.", "value": {"title": "Before the House Wakes — condition-check sheet", "body": "# Before the House Wakes — condition check

**Baseline:** Last verified January 4, 2026, after replacing the shifted lower-right mount.

## Mounting setup
- 9 × 12 in full sheet; 140-lb cold-press watercolor paper; painted image 7 × 9 in.
- 11 × 14 in archival mat with a 6.75 × 8.75 in window.
- Sheet held by conservation-grade corner mounts (including the replaced lower-right corner); no pressure-sensitive adhesive contacts the artwork.
- Framed assembly includes glazing; sheet is separated from the glazing. Glazing type, frame dimensions/material, and backing-board material are not specified in the verified notes. The former 10 × 12 in frame was replaced and is not the current setup.

## Check gently
- Confirm the sheet remains flat; inspect for moisture, tears, abrasion, staining, buckling, or other change.
- Check all corner mounts are seated and holding evenly; verify no mount or adhesive touches the painted sheet.
- Confirm the mat and window are unchanged, the sheet remains clear of glazing, and the assembly is secure.
- If damage, moisture, contact, or a shifted mount is found, stop handling and seek conservation advice rather than pressing, taping, or repairing the sheet.

**Last verified condition:** Sheet flat and undamaged, with no moisture, tear, abrasion, or adhesive contact; only the lower-right corner mount had shifted and was replaced. Reassembled securely in the Cherrywood painting corner; no further repair or professional intervention was pending. This is a dated baseline, not a claim about the present condition.", "folder": "Watercolor inventory"}}]}
